name: Halder
title: Novice Master
flavor_intro: Halder looks at you with mild disappointment.
flavor_win: You have earned your next lesson.
flavor_loss: Come back when your bruises stop whining.

name: Barak
title: Iron Coach
flavor_intro: Barak cracks his knuckles and asks if your will has insurance.
flavor_win: Good. Now stop smiling and keep training.
flavor_loss: You call that footwork? Even my lunch fights better.

name: Aladdin
title: Sandblade Mentor
flavor_intro: Aladdin twirls a curved blade and waits for an apology.
flavor_win: A clean strike. You move to harder lessons.
flavor_loss: The sand itself judged you and found you lacking.

name: Candle
title: Master of Ember Forms
flavor_intro: Candle lights a torch and says your excuses burn first.
flavor_loss: You got smoked. Literally and spiritually.

name: Prince Caspian
title: Silver Banner Master
flavor_intro: Prince Caspian salutes, then tries to remove your optimism.
flavor_win: You carry yourself like a warrior now.

name: Sparhawk
title: Veteran of Seven Wars
flavor_intro: Sparhawk sighs. Another hopeful. Another lesson.
flavor_win: Fine work. You may stand among veterans.
flavor_loss: War would eat you alive right now.

name: Atsuko Sensei
title: Storm Discipline
flavor_intro: Atsuko bows once. The room gets very quiet.
flavor_win: Calm hands. Sharp mind. You advance.
flavor_loss: Your spirit rushed. Your body paid.

name: Aragorn
title: Ranger-King Instructor
flavor_intro: Aragorn studies your stance like a battlefield map.
flavor_win: Rise. You are ready for harsher roads.
flavor_loss: Not all who wander are lost. You definitely were.

name: Borin
title: Anvil Champion
flavor_intro: Borin grins like an avalanche with a beard.
flavor_win: Strong spine. Stronger resolve. Move up.
flavor_loss: You rang the anvil. It rang back harder.

name: Eldria
title: Moonsteel Grandmaster
flavor_intro: Eldria's blade hums; your courage does a little hiccup.
flavor_win: You bear the mark of a true champion.

name: Turgon
title: Hallmaster of Honor
flavor_intro: Turgon folds his arms and squints at you like you owe him money.
flavor_win: Go. The Dragon waits for no one.
flavor_loss: You are not dragon-ready. Not today.
